description: This file defines a Builder object with methods for creating and manipulating DOM elements, including node creation, setting attributes, and appending children. It is part of the Scriptaculous library for dynamic UI effects.

methods.name: node
methods.description: Creates a DOM element of a specified type, with optional attributes and children.

methods.name: _text
methods.description: Creates a text node with the given text.

methods.name: _attributes
methods.description: Converts an attributes object into a string suitable for HTML.

methods.name: _children
methods.description: Appends children (nodes or text) to a DOM element.

methods.name: _isStringOrNumber
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is a string or number.
